nodes.label: Layered Ocean Waves
nodes.rationale: Two quadratic-curve wave paths (lighter front-back depth layering) suggest ocean depth

nodes.label: Sea Sunset Favicon
nodes.rationale: 64x64 rounded-square app icon depicting a sun setting over layered ocean waves; a miniature emblem of the sea wallpaper scene

nodes.label: Turbulence Noise Texture (turbulence.png)
nodes.description: Small tileable RGB noise texture (about 128x128) with independent, blotchy multi-octave noise in each color channel. It produces saturated rainbow patches.
nodes.rationale: A packed multi-channel noise lookup lets a shader sample several decorrelated noise values (for example UV distortion offsets) in one texture fetch, so it does not have to compute procedural noise per pixel.

nodes.label: Water Turbulence / UV Distortion
nodes.rationale: The file name and look suggest it is sampled to perturb texture coordinates for water surfaces, refraction or caustics in the sea wallpaper scene.

nodes.label: NaN skyline speck fix (M6)
nodes.rationale: Sea-floor exp() overflow gave inf*0 = NaN; clamped in GLSL and TS.

nodes.label: Performance pass (2026-10-14)
nodes.rationale: Faster renders with pixel-identical image; cloudy 4K 4.4 -> 2.9 s.

nodes.rationale: Same scene recomposed: 36 mm side maps to long image side.

nodes.label: /random route (7.18)
nodes.rationale: Second Vite page; GitHub Pages redirects /random -> /random/; main.ts forwards path in dev.

nodes.label: skyDenoise.ts edge-aware light-shaft denoise
nodes.rationale: Smooths one-sample-per-pixel light-shaft term once on final frame, weighted by log-luminance similarity.

nodes.label: Daily SwiftShader CI snapshot (latest.jpg)
nodes.rationale: CI runners have no GPU; software WebGL is slow but acceptable for one image a day.

nodes.label: Image pipeline: auto exposure, AgX tone mapping, bloom
nodes.norm_label: image pipeline: auto exposure, agx tone mapping, bloom

nodes.label: Cloud grain fix (7.19): no temporal upscaling, Halton sub-pixel jitter
nodes.norm_label: cloud grain fix (7.19): no temporal upscaling, halton sub-pixel jitter
nodes.rationale: Temporal upscaling gave each pixel a fresh ray only every 16 frames; ray marcher jittered only along rays.

nodes.label: Date-seeded deterministic SceneParams
nodes.rationale: seed = hash(YYYY-MM-DD) via cyrb128 + sfc32 so everyone sees the same scene on the same day and any date can be re-rendered.

nodes.label: Env cube shader reuse
nodes.rationale: Disposing composers after all six faces cut programs 92 -> 52 and linking 475 -> 287 ms.

nodes.label: Frame accumulation (AccumulatePass, 64 frames)
nodes.rationale: Stochastic volumetric clouds converge by averaging many frames in linear HDR; takram TAA left residual noise on static camera.

nodes.label: Procedural props (no downloaded models)
nodes.rationale: Deviation from glTF plan: zero asset weight, per-date variety, nothing external to host.

nodes.label: Rejected: shipping precomputed atmosphere LUTs
nodes.rationale: 10-48 MB download and half float changes the sky.

nodes.label: Ocean FFT on a Web Worker
nodes.norm_label: ocean fft on a web worker
nodes.rationale: Runs while main thread idles on atmosphere precompute; bit-exact output.

nodes.label: StillScenePass (cache scene colour+depth during accumulation)
nodes.rationale: Only clouds and spray change between frames; re-rendering scene each frame cost ~1.2 s at 4K.

nodes.label: Wave break redesign (7.20): roller + trail whitewater, foamLace weave
nodes.norm_label: wave break redesign (7.20): roller + trail whitewater, foamlace weave
nodes.rationale: Research on spilling breakers; fixed seaward-facing surf profile; removed round 'leopard spot' holes in foam.

nodes.label: Decision: web-only rendering (three.js)
nodes.rationale: Fits static GitHub Pages hosting; no image storage since any date is re-rendered on demand; a still allows seconds per image for supersampling. Rejected Blender/Cycles (needs external render step) and AI image generation (paid, less control).
